purpose: Next compact read-only SEO detail batch after the owned admin Save/history retest completes.

source_basis.inventory: docs/stabilization/inventory.json: EXT-F-1008 guest/admin cells remain unverified; T09/C09 is the remaining eligible detail control.
receipts: docs/stabilization/runs/seo-guest-006.json: sparse/rich detail groups and canonical door only.
docs/stabilization/runs/seo-admin-001.json: title/heading presence only; other detail values remain unverified.
docs/stabilization/runs/seo-admin-002.json: Save ID observed; history retest belongs to the current admin owner.

sequence: Run only after the current admin Save/history retest is terminal. Visit https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HTML in the owned active tab, open SEO, and wait for its live audit. Repeat the same read-only observations as guest and admin; admin reuses the authenticated session/checkpoint and must not click Save.

runner_reuse.guest: tests/browser/seo-guest-acceptance.mjs: reuse runNativeSidepanelQa, owned tab navigation, selected SEO scope, public DOM oracle and seoDetailState; add bounded observations after rich_detail_audit_wait.
runner_reuse.admin: tests/browser/seo-admin-acceptance.mjs: reuse existing admin/org session and linked-pane locators after history retest; continue directly to public detail observation without another Save.
runner_reuse.shared: tests/browser/native-sidepanel-qa-harness.mjs and tests/browser/settings-panel-driver.mjs; no new browser harness.

assertions.action: On the live Wikipedia HTML page, inspect SEO > Links in each role.
assertions.expected_evidence: Internal and external counts equal counts independently derived from the page's href anchors after URL resolution; omit the group only if both source counts are zero.

assertions.action: Inspect SEO > Images in each role.
assertions.expected_evidence: Total equals the public DOM img count and Missing alt equals images whose alt attribute is absent or empty; rendered values agree exactly.

assertions.action: Inspect SEO > Readability in each role.
assertions.expected_evidence: For nonempty page text, the group shows word and sentence counts plus a named Flesch band and numeric score; no invented zero-valued group when source text is unavailable.

assertions.action: Inspect SEO > Performance after the page navigation settles in each role.
assertions.expected_evidence: HTTP status matches the owned page response; navigation type and available duration/transfer measurements are rendered, while unavailable measurements are omitted rather than fabricated.

assertions.action: Inspect SEO > International and Structured data; activate one hreflang URL and one schema type chip with trusted clicks.
assertions.expected_evidence: Preflight the live public DOM for nonempty hreflang alternates and JSON-LD schema types; displayed values match them, schema links target the matching schema.org type page, and the hreflang door opens its observed URL in a new tab. If either source datum is absent, record that assertion unverified rather than passing it.

limits: This is a test-ready selection, not runtime coverage; do not change inventory status or reassign existing cases from this brief.
Counts only the five named T09 subtargets, not full T09 or EXT-F-1008 acceptance.
No clipboard read/write, Save, history mutation, provider recommendation, Chat/Pilot action, new database record, or member authentication.
If public-page preflight lacks required hreflang or schema data, retain that assertion as unverified; do not substitute assumed values.
